integrationSEO.title: AI assistant for Shopify and bookings
integrationSEO.intro: Whether you run a Shopify store, take bookings, or both, our AI receptionist and AI widget can answer customers in seconds, cut down on abandoned carts, and book more appointments — automatically, around the clock.

shopify.title: What can the AI assistant do for your Shopify store?
shopify.paragraph1: The AI widget sits right on your Shopify site and instantly answers visitor questions about shipping, sizing, stock, and returns — even outside business hours, when a large share of your traffic arrives. That means fewer abandoned carts and more completed purchases.
shopify.paragraph2: When a customer needs a human touch — a complicated return or a custom order — the AI hands the conversation to your team with the full context, so nobody has to start over.

shopify.title: Shopify store
shopify.text: Automatically answer product, shipping and return questions, and cut abandoned carts with an AI widget that's available 24/7 on your store.

booking.title: Bookings & appointments
booking.text: Let customers book, reschedule and cancel appointments by phone or on your site, while the AI syncs directly with your calendar and sends automatic SMS reminders.

combined.title: Webshop + bookings combined
combined.text: Sell both products and services — a clinic with a webshop, or a salon selling products — and the AI can handle order questions and appointment booking in the very same conversation.

howItWorks.title: How it works in practice
howItWorks.paragraph1: The integration connects to your Shopify store and calendar, so the AI always has up-to-date order and availability data. Setup typically takes under 15 minutes and requires no development work on your end.
howItWorks.paragraph2: The AI learns your products, prices and opening hours, and you can adjust at any time what it's allowed to answer on its own, and when it should hand a customer over to a person.
